messages.subject: Stacked DYGraph
parts:
I am trying to switch my dygraph to a stacked dygraph, but it only plots one of the 10 series.

Does anyone know what is causing the issue. My code is below and screenshots of before/after are attached.

Before:
dygraph(classificationplot, main = "Classification Topic Trend") %>%
    dyOptions(colors = c(clrs2[length(clrs2)],clrs2[1:length(clrs2)-1])) %>%
    dyLegend(show = "onmouseover",width="675") %>%
    dyAxis("y", label = "Count of Feedback") %>%
    dyAxis("x", label = "Time") %>%
    dyRangeSelector()



Aftter:
dygraph(classificationplot, main = "Classification Topic Trend") %>%
    dyOptions(stackedGraph = TRUE,colors = c(clrs2[length(clrs2)],clrs2[1:length(clrs2)-1])) %>%
    dyLegend(show = "onmouseover",width="675") %>%
    dyAxis("y", label = "Count of Feedback") %>%
    dyAxis("x", label = "Time") %>%
    dyRangeSelector()





Thanks,
Logan
